blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution expects Vice President Sara Duterte to explain, through her defense team, the items, both cash and properties, that are not in her statements of assets, liabilities, and net worth (SALNs) when her impeachment trial resumes on Nov. 9. In a press conference on Tuesday, former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers, House prosecution adviser and trial spokesman, said the prosecutors have five sets of questions that they want answered. He then presented a review of evidence already presented during previous proceedings involving Duterte’s money in banks, insurance, investments, firearms, business interests, and land. “Pangkarinderya ang drama, pero […]...
